prompt: Create an original 150 second contemporary organ music instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: pipe organ, low strings. Style: slow pedal tones and open suspended harmony. Tempo approximately 52 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A melancholic and dramatic orchestral piece featuring prominent strings and piano, building in intensity before a reflective conclusion.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而富有戏剧性的管弦乐作品，以突出的弦乐和钢琴为主，强度逐渐增强后回归沉思的结局。
